messages:
maria_eng: noticing a 2-4x tail latency on multi-GPU inference in us-west1 after NCCL 3.4.0 bump. Affected A100 pools, allgather seems to spike. @oncall please take a look
sam_runtime: can you paste canary logs? which models/seq len?
maria_eng: small batch chat models (seq 1024), replica=4, p2p and nvlink in use. Here's excerpt:
```
[collective] allgather latency: 18ms -> 120ms
ncclCommDestroy: timeout waiting for sync
```
ryan_infra: saw similar in eu-west2 on H100s but intermittent. suspect switch to new kernel/drivers. we rolled driver 530.41 -> 535.x last week
lisa_sre: rolling back NCCL to 3.3.1 on one canary rack now, will report
noah_prod: can we throttle scheduling to avoid hitting collective hotpaths? maybe move to single-gpu fallback for small seqs
sam_runtime: adding perf counters: nvlink BW, p2p queue depths, pcie drop counts. also enabling NCCL_TRACE=INFO
ci-bot: canary deployment started: canary-rack-17 -> nccl-3.3.1 (id: canary-2198765432) :eyes:
maria_eng: after rollback canary tail improved to 22ms stable, but we still see spikes on machines with mixed BIOS microcode / NVLINK firmware mismatch
ryan_infra: logging NVLINK firmware versions, also checking for mixed MOBO DMI versions. pushing a script: `scripts/check-nvlink-fw.sh`
noah_prod: what's the impact on capacity if we temporarily disable multi-gpu packs? cost will go up ~18% for peaky workloads
lisa_sre: coordination with sales/customer-facing teams needed if we expect reduced throughput tomorrow
sam_runtime: plan: (1) expand nccl-3.3 rollback to all suspect racks, (2) gather per-segment traces with NCCL_DEBUG=WARN/TRACE, (3) run synthetic allgather microbenchmarks across NVLINK topologies
maria_eng: also need kernel/driver matrix: 535.x + cuda12.2 + nccl3.4 shows perf drop on A100s with nvlink gen2
ryan_infra: submitting infra change: revert nccl-unified package to 3.3.1 and pin driver 530.41 on impacted image tags
noah_prod: temp routing policy: route multi-gpu jobs to dedicated capacity in us-east1 where we've validated 3.4, while we stabilize us-west
sam_runtime: FYI engineers: use `--prefer-single-gpu` flag for high-tail jobs until fix
maria_eng: thumbs up :thumbsup: updating incident doc -> https://redwood.internal/incidents/2198765432
lisa_sre: filing a postmortem runbook item to verify nvlink fw parity during upgrades
ci-bot: canary completed: performance regression mitigated on canary racks
ryan_infra: start roll (stagger 10 racks/hr), if rollback OK we'll pick up emergency patch release
maria_eng: thanks team, keep updates here. tagging @security for any driver/SLA implications
security_bot: acknowledged. if we change images please include SBOM diff
sam_runtime: collecting traces now, will post flamegraph + histograms in 15m
